name: Diploma in Engineering (Polytechnic)
exam: State polytechnic entrance tests (JEECUP in UP, Bihar DCECE, Delhi CET, Haryana HSTES, etc.); some states give direct merit admission.
eligibility: Class 10 pass, usually 35 to 50 percent aggregate with Maths and Science; age 14 to 21 in most states.
syllabus: Class 10 level Maths, Science (Physics and Chemistry) and English; some states add logical reasoning.
competitionDetail: Moderate overall; High for government polytechnics in top branches (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Computer).
fees: Government ₹10,000 to ₹40,000 per year; private ₹40,000 to ₹1.5 lakh per year.
duration: 3 years (4 years for part-time or sandwich courses).
outcomes: Junior Engineer, technician, supervisor, site engineer; lateral entry into B.Tech 2nd year (via LEET/state exams); PSU and railway technical posts.
salary: Private ₹2.4 to ₹4.5 LPA at start; government JE posts Pay Level 6 (₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400); with experience ₹6 to ₹10 LPA.

name: ITI (Industrial Training Institute)
exam: Merit-based or state counselling (online portals like iti.nic.in/state ITI portals); final certification through NCVT AITT exam.
eligibility: Class 8 or 10 pass depending on the trade (Electrician, Fitter, Welder, COPA, Mechanic, Plumber, Draughtsman need Class 10 mostly); age 14+.
syllabus: Trade theory, trade practical, workshop calculation and science, engineering drawing, employability skills.
competitionDetail: Low to Moderate; High for government ITIs in popular trades.
fees: Government ₹2,000 to ₹15,000 per year; private ₹20,000 to ₹80,000 per year.
duration: 1 to 2 years depending on the trade.
outcomes: Skilled worker, technician, apprenticeship (Apprentices Act) with PSUs and railways, self-employment, Railway Group D eligibility, ITI Instructor after more training, lateral entry to Diploma.
salary: ₹1.8 to ₹3.5 LPA initially; apprenticeship stipend ₹7,000 to ₹15,000 per month; Gulf and industry jobs can pay more.

name: Merchant Navy: GP Rating (General Purpose)
exam: Entrance test and interview conducted by DG Shipping approved institutes (some have an online test).
eligibility: Class 10 pass (Class 10+2 also accepted) with minimum 40 percent in English; age 17.5 to 25; medical and eyesight fitness.
syllabus: Basic English, General Science, Maths (Class 10 level), then 6-month pre-sea training including firefighting, survival at sea and seamanship.
competitionDetail: Moderate selection bar; strict physical and medical clearance.
fees: About ₹1 lakh to ₹2.5 lakh for the course.
duration: 6 months training plus sea service contracts.
outcomes: Rating on merchant ships (deck or engine side), growth to Able Seaman and Bosun; a route to Officer level after further study.
salary: ₹20,000 to ₹40,000 per month at start, mostly tax-free for sea time; senior ratings ₹60,000 to ₹1.2 lakh per month.

name: Short Computer and Skill Courses (NIELIT CCC / O Level / Tally)
hindiTitle: कंप्यूटर व स्किल सर्टिफिकेशन (CCC / टैली / डिजिटल मार्केटिंग)
exam: NIELIT CCC, O Level, Tally, DCA, Digital Marketing, Graphic Design, Spoken English, Beauty and Wellness (Skill India/PMKVY).
eligibility: Usually Class 10 pass (CCC has no age or qualification bar).
syllabus: CCC covers computer basics, MS Office, internet and digital financial services; others are skill-specific.
competitionDetail: Low barrier to entry; direct certification examinations.
fees: CCC about ₹600; other courses ₹3,000 to ₹40,000.
outcomes: Data entry, office assistant, shop and billing jobs, freelancing; useful as an add-on to any academic path and required in many state government jobs.
salary: ₹1.5 to ₹3 LPA at entry; freelancers vary widely.

name: SSC MTS (Multi-Tasking Staff) and Havaldar
exam: SSC MTS and Havaldar in CBIC and CBN (Computer Based Test, plus Physical Efficiency and Standards Test for Havaldar).
eligibility: Class 10 pass; age 18 to 25 (MTS), 18 to 27 (Havaldar) with category relaxation.
syllabus: Numerical Aptitude, Reasoning Ability, General Awareness, English Language (and Hindi in some papers); basic level.
competitionDetail: Extreme (millions apply for a few thousand to lakhs of vacancies, depending on the year).
fees: ₹100 (free for women, SC, ST, PwBD and ex-servicemen).
outcomes: Peon, office attendant, daftri, junior gestetner operator, and similar posts in central government offices; promotions possible to LDC and higher through departmental exams.
salary: Pay Level 1 (₹18,000 to ₹56,900); in-hand around ₹22,000 to ₹30,000 per month.

name: SSC GD Constable (CAPF, NIA, SSF, Assam Rifles)
exam: SSC GD CBT, then Physical Standard Test, Physical Efficiency Test (race, etc.), and medical exam.
eligibility: Class 10 pass; age 18 to 23; minimum height 170 cm for men and 157 cm for women (relaxations for some categories and regions); chest 80 cm unexpanded for men.
syllabus: General Intelligence and Reasoning, General Knowledge and Awareness, Elementary Mathematics, English or Hindi.
competitionDetail: Extreme (lakhs of vacancies in some years but very large applicant pools).
fees: ₹100 (exempt for women, SC, ST, ESM).
duration: 1 year typical cycle, followed by training.
outcomes: Constable in BSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB, Assam Rifles, NIA; promotions to Head Constable and ASI by seniority and departmental exams; pension through NPS.
salary: Pay Level 3 (₹21,700 to ₹69,100) plus risk, ration and special duty allowances; in-hand ₹30,000 to ₹40,000.

name: RRB Group D (Railway Level 1)
exam: CBT (about 100 questions, 90 minutes), Physical Efficiency Test (lifting and running), document verification, medical.
eligibility: Class 10 pass or ITI (NCVT) or equivalent; age 18 to 33 with relaxations.
syllabus: Mathematics (25 questions), General Intelligence and Reasoning (30), General Science (25), General Awareness and Current Affairs (20); all at Class 10 level.
competitionDetail: Extreme (crores of applicants for about 1 lakh posts in recent cycles).
fees: ₹500 (partly refunded after appearing in the CBT); lower for reserved categories.
duration: About 1 to 1.5 years from notification to joining.
outcomes: Track maintainer, assistant pointsman, helper in various railway departments; departmental exams for promotion to higher grades.
salary: Pay Level 1 (₹18,000 to ₹56,900); in-hand about ₹30,000 to ₹35,000 in cities with allowances.

name: India Post: Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS)
exam: No written exam; selection through merit list made on Class 10 marks (online application on indiapostgdsonline.gov.in).
eligibility: Class 10 pass with Maths and English passed; knowledge of local language; age 18 to 40; basic computer knowledge and ability to ride a cycle.
syllabus: None (merit-based on Class 10 percentage).
competitionDetail: High (thousands to tens of thousands of vacancies but cut-offs are very high, often above 90 percent in many circles).
fees: ₹100 (free for women, SC, ST, PwBD).
outcomes: Branch Postmaster, Assistant Branch Postmaster, Dak Sevak in rural post offices; part-time-style engagement; departmental exams to become Postal Assistant.
salary: TRCA about ₹10,000 to ₹29,380 per month (BPM higher, ABPM and Dak Sevak lower); allowances extra.

name: Indian Army Agniveer (GD, Tech, Clerk, Tradesman)
exam: Common Entrance Exam (online), Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical exam, rally and documents.
eligibility: Class 10 pass with at least 45 percent overall and 33 percent in each subject (GD); age 17.5 to 21; Tradesman 8th/10th depending on trade; unmarried.
syllabus: General Knowledge, General Science, Maths (Class 10 level).
competitionDetail: Very High to Extreme physical and written standards.
fees: About ₹250 per application.
duration: 4-year engagement; about 25 percent are retained for 15 more years based on performance.
outcomes: Soldier in the Indian Army; Seva Nidhi lump sum on exit; preference in CAPF, state police and other jobs; skill certification during service.
salary: About ₹30,000 per month in year 1 up to ₹40,000 in year 4 (package), with about 70 percent in hand; Seva Nidhi roughly ₹10 lakh at exit (check latest rules).

name: Indian Coast Guard Navik (Domestic Branch)
exam: Stage I online test, Stage II physical fitness and document check, Stage III and IV medicals and final merit.
eligibility: Class 10 pass; age 18 to 22; minimum height 157 cm; medical fitness.
syllabus: Class 10 level Maths, Science, English, General Knowledge and Reasoning.
competitionDetail: High competition with nationwide coastal deployment.
fees: ₹300 (nil for SC and ST).
duration: Selection cycle 6 to 8 months; 22 weeks of training at INS Chilka; service 20 years.
outcomes: Cook and Steward posts on Coast Guard ships; promotions to Pradhan Navik and Navik Pradhan Adhikari; pension eligible after the service period.
salary: Pay Level 3 (₹21,700 to ₹69,100) plus Dearness and Dress allowances.

name: B.Tech / B.E. (Engineering)
exam: JEE Main (NITs, IIITs, GFTIs), JEE Advanced (IITs), BITSAT, VITEEE, SRMJEEE, state CETs (BCECE, MHT CET, KCET, WBJEE, UPSEE-type exams).
eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Maths; about 75 percent (65 percent for SC/ST) for IIT/NIT counselling or top 20 percentile; 60 percent for most colleges. JEE Advanced: max 2 attempts in 2 consecutive years.
syllabus: NCERT Class 11 and 12 Physics, Chemistry and Maths (JEE Main has 75 questions, 300 marks; JEE Advanced is deeper and application-based).
competitionDetail: Extreme for IITs and NITs (about 14 lakh JEE Main candidates, roughly 2.5 lakh qualify for Advanced, and only about 17,000 IIT seats); Moderate for private colleges.
fees: IIT about ₹2 to ₹2.5 lakh per year; NIT about ₹1.2 to ₹1.5 lakh per year; private ₹1 to ₹4 lakh per year; state government colleges ₹30,000 to ₹1 lakh per year.
outcomes: Software engineer, core engineer (Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, Electronics), data scientist, product manager; M.Tech via GATE; PSU jobs via GATE; MBA via CAT; UPSC.
salary: IIT average ₹10 to ₹25 LPA (top packages ₹1 crore plus); NIT ₹6 to ₹15 LPA; tier-2/3 colleges ₹3 to ₹6 LPA.

name: B.Arch (Architecture)
exam: JEE Main Paper 2 (Maths, Aptitude, Drawing) or NATA (Council of Architecture).
eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Maths and at least 50 percent aggregate (45 percent for reserved).
syllabus: Mathematics, general aptitude (visual perception, logical reasoning), drawing and design sensitivity.
competitionDetail: High for top colleges (SPA, NIT, IIT), Moderate otherwise.
fees: ₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh per year depending on the institution.
outcomes: Architect, urban planner, interior designer, landscape architect; M.Arch / M.Plan; government posts in PWD, CPWD, Town Planning.
salary: ₹3 to ₹8 LPA at start; senior architects and own practice ₹15 LPA plus.

name: B.Sc / Integrated M.Sc (Pure Sciences)
exam: CUET UG; IISER Aptitude Test (IAT); NEST (NISER/CBS); IIT JAM later for M.Sc; ISI and CMI entrance for Maths and Statistics.
eligibility: Class 12 science (PCM or PCB depending on the subject) with 50 to 60 percent.
syllabus: Class 11 and 12 Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology (IAT and NEST have multiple-choice science papers).
competitionDetail: Very High for IISER, NISER, CMI and ISI; Low to Moderate for general universities.
fees: Universities ₹5,000 to ₹50,000 per year; IISER about ₹30,000 to ₹1 lakh per year (with scholarships like INSPIRE).
duration: 3 years (B.Sc), 4 years (Honours with research under NEP) or 5 years (Integrated MSc/BS-MS).
outcomes: Scientist (ISRO, DRDO, CSIR, BARC via exams), researcher (PhD), lecturer (NET/SET), data analyst, forensic and environmental science careers.
salary: ₹2.5 to ₹6 LPA at start; research fellowships ₹31,000 to ₹35,000 per month (JRF); scientists Level 10 (₹56,100) and above.

name: BCA / B.Sc Computer Science / B.Sc Data Science
hindiTitle: बीसीए / बी.एससी डेटा साइंस / कंप्यूटर साइंस
exam: CUET UG, IPU CET, NPAT, university or college tests.
eligibility: Class 12 pass in any stream (many colleges ask for Maths) with 50 percent.
syllabus: Programming (C, C++, Java, Python), Data Structures, DBMS, Web Technologies, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Maths and Statistics.
competitionDetail: Moderate to High for top central universities; widely available across private/state colleges.
fees: ₹30,000 to ₹2 lakh per year.
duration: 3 years (4 years under NEP with Honours).
outcomes: Software developer, web developer, tester, analyst; MCA (NIMCET) or MBA after.
salary: ₹3 to ₹8 LPA; product companies pay more for strong coding skills.

name: Merchant Navy Officer (B.Tech Marine / B.Sc Nautical)
exam: IMU CET (Indian Maritime University Common Entrance Test); other approved institutes have their own tests.
eligibility: Class 12 PCM with at least 60 percent and English 50 percent; age 17 to 25; strict medical and eyesight norms (colour vision for deck cadets).
syllabus: Physics, Chemistry, Maths, English and General Aptitude.
competitionDetail: High for IMU government campuses; Moderate for private institutes.
fees: ₹3 to ₹8 lakh for the full program (IMU is lower).
outcomes: Deck cadet to Captain, Engine cadet to Chief Engineer; shore jobs in ports and shipping.
salary: Trainee ₹15,000 to ₹30,000 per month; Third/Fourth Officer ₹1 to ₹1.5 lakh per month; Captain/Chief Engineer ₹5 lakh per month plus (largely tax-free for long sea service).

name: Commercial Pilot (CPL)
exam: DGCA ground-school papers (Air Navigation, Meteorology, Regulations, Technical General/Specific), DGCA Class 1 and Class 2 medical; flying schools or IGRUA run their own selection.
eligibility: Class 12 with Physics and Maths (minimum 50 percent); age 17 or above (18 for CPL); medically fit; English proficiency.
syllabus: Aerodynamics, aircraft systems, navigation, meteorology, air regulations, radio telephony, plus 200 hours of flying.
competitionDetail: Moderate in entrance testing but extremely capital-intensive; high competition for airline first officer slots.
fees: ₹40 to ₹80 lakh (training in India or abroad).
outcomes: First Officer then Captain in airlines, charter and cargo operators, flying instructor.
salary: First Officer ₹10 to ₹30 LPA; Captain ₹40 LPA to ₹1 crore plus.

name: MBBS (Doctor / Medicine)
exam: NEET UG (conducted by NTA) for all government and private medical colleges including AIIMS and JIPMER.
eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, English; at least 50 percent (40 percent for SC/ST/OBC, 45 percent PwBD); minimum age 17.
syllabus: NCERT Class 11 and 12 Physics, Chemistry, Botany and Zoology; 180 questions, 720 marks.
competitionDetail: Extreme (about 20+ lakh candidates for roughly 1.1 to 1.2 lakh MBBS seats across all India).
fees: Government ₹10,000 to ₹1.5 lakh per year (AIIMS very low); private ₹10 to ₹25 lakh per year (total ₹50 lakh to ₹1.5 crore).
duration: 5.5 years (4.5 years academics plus 1 year compulsory internship).
outcomes: Doctor, specialist via NEET PG (MD/MS), UPSC CMS, Army Medical Corps, government hospitals, research and public health.
salary: Intern stipend ₹20,000 to ₹50,000 per month; Medical Officer ₹60,000 to ₹1.2 lakh per month; specialists ₹15 to ₹50 LPA plus.

name: BDS, BAMS, BHMS, BUMS, BVSc & AH
hindiTitle: बीडीएस / बीएएमएस / पशु चिकित्सा (आयुष व डेंटल)
exam: NEET UG followed by MCC or state counselling (AYUSH counselling for BAMS, BHMS, BUMS).
eligibility: Class 12 PCB with the same marks as MBBS; BVSc requires qualifying NEET.
syllabus: NEET syllabus, then respective professional subjects.
competitionDetail: Very High for government seats; Moderate for private.
fees: Government ₹5,000 to ₹1 lakh per year; private ₹1 to ₹9 lakh per year (BDS higher).
duration: BDS 5 years, BAMS/BHMS/BUMS 5.5 years, BVSc 5 years.
outcomes: Dentist, Ayurvedic/Homeopathic doctor, veterinary doctor, government AYUSH Medical Officer, own clinic, wellness industry.
salary: ₹3 to ₹10 LPA; own clinics can earn more; government AYUSH/Vet posts Level 10 (₹56,100) onwards.

name: B.Sc Nursing and Allied Health (BPT, BMLT, Radiology)
hindiTitle: बी.एससी नर्सिंग एवं एलाइड हेल्थ (फिजियोथेरेपी / लैब)
exam: State nursing/paramedical entrance exams, NEET for some seats, AIIMS Nursing exam, merit in many states.
eligibility: Class 12 PCB (45 to 50 percent minimum); PCM allowed for some allied courses.
syllabus: Class 11 and 12 Biology, Physics, Chemistry and English.
competitionDetail: Moderate overall; High for AIIMS and top government colleges.
fees: Government ₹5,000 to ₹50,000 per year; private ₹50,000 to ₹2 lakh per year.
duration: B.Sc Nursing 4 years; allied health 3 to 4 years including internship.
outcomes: Staff nurse, physiotherapist, lab technologist, radiographer; government jobs through NORCET (AIIMS), state health departments and Army Nursing Service (MNS).
salary: ₹2.5 to ₹6 LPA in India; ₹25 to ₹60 lakh per year abroad for nurses (with licensing).

name: D.Pharm / B.Pharm
exam: State CETs or merit (e.g., Bihar BCECE, MHT CET, KCET); GPAT or NIPER JEE for M.Pharm later.
eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology or Maths; 50 percent.
syllabus: Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Maths of Class 11 and 12.
competitionDetail: Low to Moderate; widespread college availability.
fees: ₹30,000 to ₹2 lakh per year.
outcomes: Pharmacist (registered), medical representative, drug inspector, QA/QC in pharma industry, own medical store, M.Pharm / MBA.
salary: ₹2.4 to ₹6 LPA; drug inspector (government) Level 8 (₹47,600 onwards).

name: B.Sc Agriculture / Horticulture / Forestry
exam: CUET UG (ICAR AIEEA UG seats are now through CUET), state agricultural university tests.
eligibility: Class 12 with PCB or PCM or Agriculture, minimum 50 percent.
syllabus: Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Maths of Class 12.
competitionDetail: High for ICAR central institutions; Moderate for state agricultural colleges.
fees: Government ₹15,000 to ₹60,000 per year; private ₹80,000 to ₹2 lakh per year.
outcomes: Agriculture Officer, ICAR scientist (ARS via NET), bank Agriculture Field Officer (IBPS AFO), agri-business, forest services after further exams, own agri-enterprise.
salary: ₹3 to ₹8 LPA; government Level 8 to 10.

name: Chartered Accountant (CA)
exam: ICAI CA Foundation (can register after Class 10 or 12), Intermediate, Articleship (3 years practical training), Final.
eligibility: Class 12 pass (direct entry to Intermediate for graduates with 55 percent in Commerce or 60 percent otherwise).
syllabus: Accounting, Business Laws, Quantitative Aptitude, Business Economics (Foundation); Advanced Accounting, Corporate Law, Taxation, Costing, Audit, FM and SM (Inter and Final).
competitionDetail: Extreme in academic difficulty (Final pass rate is typically 10 to 20 percent per attempt).
fees: ICAI registration and exam fees about ₹50,000 to ₹80,000 in total; coaching ₹50,000 to ₹2 lakh.
outcomes: Auditor, tax consultant, finance manager, CFO, Big 4, investment banking, own practice; government posts (CAG, CBDT) via UPSC and SSC.
salary: Fresher ₹7 to ₹9 LPA on average (Big 4 ₹9 to ₹13 LPA); experienced ₹25 LPA to ₹1 crore.

name: Company Secretary (CS)
exam: ICSI CSEET, Executive Programme, Professional Programme (+ 15-month training).
eligibility: Class 12 pass (graduates take direct Executive route).
syllabus: Company Law, Securities Laws, Governance, Business Laws, Tax Laws, Banking and Insurance Law, Drafting.
competitionDetail: High academic bar (selective pass percentages), fewer candidates than CA.
outcomes: Compliance Officer, Company Secretary in listed companies, legal advisor, practising CS; also eligible for government roles in SEBI, RBI (Grade B legal), banks.
salary: ₹5 to ₹10 LPA; senior CS ₹20 LPA plus.

name: Cost and Management Accountant (CMA)
exam: ICMAI Foundation, Intermediate, Final plus practical training.
eligibility: Class 12 pass (graduates can start from Intermediate).
syllabus: Cost Accounting, Financial Accounting, Taxation, Management Accounting, Strategic Management, Corporate Laws.
competitionDetail: Moderate to High; steady industry demand in manufacturing & PSUs.
fees: ₹30,000 to ₹50,000 plus coaching.
outcomes: Cost accountant, financial analyst, cost auditor, PSU finance jobs (campus placement), consulting.
salary: ₹5 to ₹9 LPA; senior roles ₹15 LPA plus.

name: B.Com / BBA / BMS / B.A. Economics
exam: CUET UG, DU/IPU/NPAT/SET and college-level entrances.
eligibility: Class 12 any stream (Commerce preferred; Maths for Economics Hons.); 50 to 60 percent.
syllabus: Accounting, Business Law, Economics, Statistics, Marketing, HR, Finance.
competitionDetail: High for top colleges (SRCC, Hansraj, St. Xavier's, Christ); Moderate across general colleges.
fees: Government ₹5,000 to ₹50,000 per year; private ₹1 to ₹5 lakh per year.
outcomes: Accountant, analyst, banker, marketing executive; MBA (CAT/XAT/CMAT), M.Com, CA/CS/CMA add-ons, bank exams, SSC and UPSC.
salary: ₹2.5 to ₹6 LPA at entry.

name: IPM (Integrated Programme in Management - IIMs)
exam: IPMAT (IIM Indore, IIM Ranchi, IIM Bodh Gaya, etc.), JIPMAT (IIM Jammu, IIM Bodh Gaya) and own aptitude tests at some IIMs.
eligibility: Class 12 pass with 60 percent (55 percent for reserved); age limits around 20 years.
syllabus: Quantitative Ability (Class 12 level), Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension; some IIMs add Logical Reasoning.
competitionDetail: Extreme (Lakhs apply for a few hundred seats across participating IIMs).
fees: ₹15 to ₹25 lakh for the five-year program.
outcomes: Management careers in consulting, finance and marketing with IIM MBA degree.
salary: ₹15 to ₹25 LPA average placements.

name: Integrated Law (BA LLB / BBA LLB / B.Com LLB)
exam: CLAT (NLUs), AILET (NLU Delhi), LSAT-India, SLAT, state law CETs.
eligibility: Class 12 any stream, 45 percent (40 percent SC/ST); no upper age limit for CLAT.
syllabus: English Language, Current Affairs and GK, Legal Reasoning, Logical Reasoning, Quantitative Techniques (CLAT UG: 120 questions, 2 hours, passage-based).
competitionDetail: Very High (60,000+ candidates for roughly 3,000 NLU seats nationwide).
fees: NLUs ₹2 to ₹3 lakh per year; private ₹1 to ₹4 lakh per year.
outcomes: Advocate, corporate lawyer, legal advisor, judge (State PCS-J / Judicial Services), government law officer; UPSC, LLM, NET.
salary: ₹4 to ₹10 LPA at firms; top law firms ₹15 to ₹25 LPA; litigators start low (₹20,000 to ₹50,000 per month).

name: B.A. (Humanities) and Social Sciences
exam: CUET UG (History, Political Science, Geography, Sociology, Psychology, English, Economics).
eligibility: Class 12 any stream; 50 percent.
syllabus: Core and elective subject papers of Class 12 level, general test, and language.
competitionDetail: High at DU, JNU, BHU; Moderate elsewhere.
fees: Government ₹5,000 to ₹30,000 per year; private ₹1 to ₹5 lakh per year.
outcomes: UPSC and State PCS foundation, teaching (NET/SET), social work, policy research, journalism, NGO work, M.A. and PhD.
salary: ₹2 to ₹6 LPA at entry; government roles per pay level.

name: Journalism and Mass Communication (BJMC / BMM)
exam: CUET UG, university entrances (Symbiosis SET, DU JMC, IP University), IIMC (postgraduate).
eligibility: Class 12 any stream; 50 percent.
syllabus: General awareness, English, current affairs, aptitude, communication and creativity.
competitionDetail: Moderate to High for top media institutes.
fees: ₹30,000 to ₹3 lakh per year.
outcomes: Reporter, content writer, anchor, video editor, PR executive, social media manager, digital media; Information Service posts (IIS) via UPSC.
salary: ₹2.5 to ₹7 LPA; anchors and senior editors ₹15 LPA plus.

name: Design (B.Des / B.FTech / Fine Arts / Animation)
exam: NID DAT (Prelims and Mains), UCEED (IITs), NIFT entrance (CAT + GAT + Situation Test), CEED for postgraduate.
eligibility: Class 12 any stream; age limit around 20 to 23 for B.Des.
syllabus: Design aptitude, drawing, visualisation, creativity, logical reasoning, general knowledge and a studio test/interview.
competitionDetail: Very High for premier institutes (NID, IIT design schools, NIFT).
fees: NID/NIFT about ₹2 to ₹3.5 lakh per year; private ₹1.5 to ₹5 lakh per year.
outcomes: UI/UX designer, product designer, fashion designer, graphic designer, animator, game artist, interior designer.
salary: ₹4 to ₹12 LPA at design-focused companies; freelancers vary.

name: Hotel Management (BHM / B.Sc HHA)
exam: NCHM JEE (National Council for Hotel Management Joint Entrance Exam) and private-institute tests.
eligibility: Class 12 pass in any stream with English as a subject; age typically up to 22 to 25.
syllabus: Numerical Ability and Analytical Aptitude, Reasoning and Logical Deduction, General Knowledge and Current Affairs, English Language, Aptitude for Service Sector.
competitionDetail: Moderate to High for top IHMs (Pusa, Mumbai).
fees: IHMs ₹1 to ₹2.5 lakh total; private ₹3 to ₹10 lakh total.
outcomes: Hotel manager, chef, front-office manager, airline and cruise-ship jobs, event management, hospitality entrepreneurship.
salary: ₹2.5 to ₹6 LPA; cruise and international roles pay much higher.

name: Integrated B.Ed (ITEP) and Teaching Programs
exam: NCET (National Common Entrance Test for ITEP), state B.Ed/D.El.Ed entrances.
eligibility: Class 12 with 50 percent (subject combinations depend on specialisation).
syllabus: General Test, Language, Domain subjects, Teaching Aptitude.
competitionDetail: Moderate; High for premier central/state education colleges.
fees: ₹30,000 to ₹1 lakh per year.
outcomes: School teacher (TGT/PGT after further study), eligibility for CTET/State TET; KVS, NVS and state school jobs.
salary: Private ₹2.5 to ₹6 LPA; government teacher Level 6 to 8 (₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400 and above).

name: NDA / NA (National Defence Academy & Naval Academy)
streamRequired: Any for Army; PCM for Air Force & Navy
exam: UPSC NDA and NA examination (twice a year), followed by SSB interview (5 days) and medical.
eligibility: Class 12 (any stream for Army wing; Physics and Maths for Air Force and Navy wings); unmarried male and female candidates; age 16.5 to 19.5 years.
syllabus: Mathematics (300 marks; Class 11 and 12 level) and General Ability Test (600 marks: English and General Knowledge including Physics, Chemistry, History, Geography, Current Events); SSB 900 marks.
competitionDetail: Extreme (about 6 to 8 lakh candidates for around 400 vacancies).
fees: ₹100 (nil for women, SC/ST and sons of JCOs/NCOs/ORs).
duration: 3 years at NDA (Khadakwasla) plus 1 year at IMA/INA/AFA.
outcomes: Permanent Commission as Officer in Army, Navy or Air Force plus free B.A./B.Sc/B.Tech degree and complete training expenses by the government.
salary: Cadet stipend ₹56,100 per month during training; Lieutenant Level 10 (₹56,100 to ₹1,77,500) plus Military Service Pay and allowances.

name: Indian Army TES & Navy B.Tech Entry (10+2 Technical Entry)
hindiTitle: सेना टीईएस एवं नेवी बी.टेक एंट्री (सीधा एसएसबी)
exam: Valid JEE Main score, shortlisting and SSB (5 days), medical.
eligibility: Class 12 with PCM (at least 60 percent aggregate in PCM); age 16.5 to 19.5; unmarried.
syllabus: JEE Main syllabus for shortlisting; SSB covers psychology tests, GTO tasks and interview.
competitionDetail: High (limited vacancies, around 90 to 100 for Army TES and about 30 to 40 for Navy B.Tech).
fees: No application fee; training and degree are fully sponsored.
duration: 4 years of engineering training at Officer Training academies.
outcomes: Permanent Commission as Lieutenant in Army or Sub-Lieutenant in Navy with B.Tech degree.
salary: Stipend ₹56,100 per month during training; after commissioning Level 10 (₹56,100 to ₹1,77,500) plus allowances.

name: Agniveer: Navy (SSR/MR) and Air Force (Agniveervayu)
exam: Online Common Entrance Test (INET for Navy, Agniveervayu Intake Test), Physical Fitness Test, Adaptability Test, Medical.
eligibility: Class 12 with Maths and Physics (Agniveervayu: 50 percent with English 50 percent; Navy SSR: Maths and Physics with one of Chemistry, Biology or Computer Science); age 17.5 to 21.
syllabus: English, Physics, Maths (Class 12 level) and Reasoning and General Awareness for non-science options.
competitionDetail: Very High competitive entrance & fitness tests.
fees: About ₹250 to ₹550 per application.
duration: 4-year engagement; about 25 percent are retained for 15 more years.
outcomes: Sailor (Navy) or Airman (Air Force) with Seva Nidhi lump sum on exit and state or central police and CAPF preference.
salary: About ₹30,000 to ₹40,000 per month (with about 70 percent in hand); Seva Nidhi about ₹10 lakh at exit (check latest rules).

name: SSC CHSL (Combined Higher Secondary Level)
streamRequired: Any (DEO in some depts needs Science with Maths)
exam: Tier 1 (CBT, 100 questions, 60 minutes), Tier 2 (descriptive paper and Skill/Typing test).
eligibility: Class 12 pass (DEO in some departments requires Science with Maths); age 18 to 27 with relaxations.
syllabus: General Intelligence and Reasoning, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude (Class 10 level), English Comprehension and Vocabulary.
competitionDetail: Extreme (more than 30 lakh applicants for roughly 3,000 to 4,500 vacancies in recent cycles).
fees: ₹100 (free for women, SC, ST, PwBD, ESM).
duration: 12 to 18 months for the whole process.
outcomes: Lower Division Clerk (LDC)/Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA), Postal/Sorting Assistant, Data Entry Operator, Court Clerk in central ministries and offices; can reach Assistant and Section Officer through departmental exams (LDCE).
salary: Pay Level 2 to 4 (₹19,900 to ₹81,100); in-hand ₹30,000 to ₹45,000 per month in cities.

name: SSC Stenographer (Grade C and D)
exam: Computer-Based Examination followed by a Skill Test (shorthand dictation and transcription).
eligibility: Class 12 pass; age 18 to 30 (Grade C) and 18 to 27 (Grade D) with relaxations.
syllabus: General Intelligence and Reasoning, General Awareness, English Language and Comprehension; skill test of 100 wpm (Grade C) and 80 wpm (Grade D).
competitionDetail: High to Very High; significantly lower applicant pool than CHSL due to specialized shorthand requirement.
fees: ₹100 (exemptions for women and reserved categories).
outcomes: Stenographer/PA in ministries and departments; promotions to Private Secretary and Section Officer.
salary: Pay Level 4 (₹25,500 to ₹81,100) for both grades; in-hand about ₹35,000 to ₹45,000 per month.

name: RRB NTPC (Class 12 Level Posts)
exam: CBT 1, CBT 2, Typing Skill Test or Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT), document verification, medical.
eligibility: Class 12 pass (Class 12 level posts); age 18 to 30 with relaxations; typing skill for Junior Clerk and Accounts Clerk.
syllabus: Mathematics, General Intelligence and Reasoning, General Awareness (Class 10 to 12 level).
competitionDetail: Extreme applicant numbers across railway recruitment boards.
fees: ₹500 (partly refundable); ₹250 for reserved categories.
outcomes: Commercial cum Ticket Clerk, Accounts Clerk cum Typist, Junior Clerk cum Typist, Trains Clerk; promotion to Station Master and higher.

name: State Police Constable / Fireman
exam: State recruitment boards (e.g., Bihar CSBC, UP Police Recruitment Board, Rajasthan Police): written exam, Physical Standard Test (PST), Physical Efficiency Test (PET), document and medical verification.
eligibility: Class 12 pass (some states accept Class 10 for specific posts); age about 18 to 25 (varies by state and category); height and chest standards.
syllabus: General Knowledge, General Hindi/English, Reasoning, Basic Maths, Current Affairs and State GK.
competitionDetail: Very High to Extreme; millions of applicants per state notification.
fees: ₹100 to ₹700 depending on the state.
duration: 8 to 18 months for selection and 6 to 9 months of training.
outcomes: Police Constable, Head Constable, ASI, SI (via graduation-based recruitment), firefighter.
salary: Approximately Pay Level 3 (₹21,700 to ₹69,100); varies by state.

name: Primary School Teacher (D.El.Ed / B.El.Ed + TET)
exam: CTET/State TET, then state teacher recruitment exams (e.g., Bihar BPSC TRE).
eligibility: Class 12 with 50 percent plus D.El.Ed (2 years) or B.El.Ed (4 years); age limit usually 18 to 37 (state-specific).
syllabus: Child Development and Pedagogy, Language I and II, Mathematics, Environmental Studies (Paper 1, Classes 1 to 5).
competitionDetail: High to Very High competition across BPSC TRE and state vacancy rallies.
fees: D.El.Ed ₹10,000 to ₹80,000 total; TET fee ₹500 to ₹1,000.
duration: 2 to 4 years of study plus recruitment time.
outcomes: Primary school teacher in state government schools; KVS/NVS posts (with further qualifications); permanent job with pension in many states.
salary: About ₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400 (Level 6) in states following central scales; ₹25,000 to ₹45,000 in-hand in some states.

name: Indian Coast Guard Navik (General Duty)
exam: Stage I (online), Stage II (physical fitness and document check), Stage III, IV (medical, final merit).
eligibility: Class 12 with Mathematics and Physics (min 50 percent); age 18 to 22; height 157 cm.
syllabus: Class 11 and 12 Maths and Physics, plus English, GK and Reasoning at Class 10 level.
competitionDetail: High standard online test and physical fitness verification at INS Chilka.
fees: ₹300 (nil for SC/ST).
duration: About 6 to 8 months selection; 22 weeks training at INS Chilka.
outcomes: Navik (GD) in Coast Guard; promotions to Pradhan Navik and Navik Pradhan Adhikari; pension.
salary: Pay Level 3 (₹21,700 to ₹69,100) plus DA and allowances.

name: MBA / PGDM
exam: CAT (IIMs and top B-schools), XAT (XLRI), CMAT, NMAT, SNAP, MAT, GMAT; then Group Discussion/Written Ability Test and Personal Interview.
eligibility: Graduation in any stream with 50 percent (45 percent for SC/ST/PwBD); final-year students can apply; work experience preferred for some programs.
syllabus: Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension (VARC), Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning (DILR), Quantitative Aptitude (QA) up to Class 10 level plus puzzles and sets.
competitionDetail: Extreme for IIMs (about 3 lakh CAT takers for roughly 5,000 to 6,000 seats in 21 IIMs); Moderate for other B-schools.
fees: Old IIMs ₹23 to ₹35 lakh; new IIMs and top private ₹10 to ₹20 lakh; other colleges ₹3 to ₹10 lakh.
outcomes: Management roles in consulting, banking, marketing, operations, HR, product management, entrepreneurship.
salary: Top IIMs average ₹25 to ₹35 LPA; tier-2 B-schools ₹8 to ₹15 LPA; others ₹4 to ₹8 LPA.

name: M.Tech / M.E. / MS (Engineering Postgraduate)
exam: GATE (conducted by IITs) for IITs, NITs, IIITs and PSU recruitment; state PGCETs (e.g., TANCET, MAH-CET).
eligibility: B.E./B.Tech or equivalent (final-year students can appear); no age limit for GATE.
syllabus: Engineering Mathematics, General Aptitude (15 marks) and the core subjects of your branch (65 questions, 100 marks, 3 hours).
competitionDetail: Very High to Extreme (about 7 to 8 lakh registrations; roughly 15 to 20 percent qualify).
fees: IIT/NIT about ₹50,000 to ₹2 lakh per year; GATE exam fee about ₹1,000 to ₹2,000.
outcomes: R&D engineer, PSU engineer, faculty (Assistant Professor), PhD; abroad via MS.
salary: MoE GATE scholarship ₹12,400 per month during M.Tech; jobs ₹6 to ₹20 LPA; PSUs ₹12 to ₹20 LPA.

name: M.Sc / M.A. / M.Com / MCA
streamRequired: Bachelor's degree in related subject (MCA needs Maths)
exam: CUET PG, IIT JAM (M.Sc at IITs), NIMCET (MCA at NITs), BHU PET, university-specific entrance tests.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree in the related subject with 50 to 60 percent; MCA requires Maths in Class 12 or graduation.
syllabus: Graduation-level subject syllabus (MCQ-based); NIMCET covers Maths, Analytical Ability and Logical Reasoning, Computer Awareness and English.
competitionDetail: High for IITs, NITs, DU, JNU, BHU; Moderate elsewhere.
fees: Government ₹5,000 to ₹80,000 per year; IIT M.Sc ₹1 lakh per year; private ₹50,000 to ₹2 lakh per year.
outcomes: Lecturer (via NET), researcher (PhD), scientist, analyst, software developer (MCA), government jobs requiring a PG qualification.
salary: ₹3 to ₹10 LPA depending on field; MCA from NITs often ₹6 to ₹12 LPA.

name: LLB (3 Years) and LLM
exam: DU LLB, BHU LLB, state law CETs (e.g., MH CET Law, TS LAWCET, PU LLB) for LLB; CLAT PG and AILET PG for LLM.
eligibility: Graduation in any stream with 45 to 50 percent (for 3-year LLB); LLB required for LLM.
syllabus: Legal aptitude, Logical Reasoning, English, General Knowledge and Current Affairs; CLAT PG tests Constitutional Law and core law subjects.
competitionDetail: High for top law faculties (DU, BHU) and premier NLUs.
fees: Government ₹10,000 to ₹80,000 per year; private ₹60,000 to ₹2.5 lakh per year.
outcomes: Advocate, corporate counsel, legal advisor, Judicial Services (PCS-J), law officer, academic career (UGC NET).
salary: ₹3 to ₹10 LPA at start; top corporate firms ₹15 to ₹25 LPA.

name: MD / MS / MDS (Medical Postgraduate)
exam: NEET PG (NBEMS) for MD/MS/Diploma; NEET MDS for dental; INI-CET for AIIMS/JIPMER.
eligibility: MBBS (or BDS for MDS) with completed internship and permanent registration.
syllabus: MBBS subjects including Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry, Pathology, Pharmacology, Medicine, Surgery, OBG, PSM and others (200 MCQs, 800 marks).
competitionDetail: Extreme for clinical branches (about 2 to 2.5 lakh candidates for roughly 70,000 PG seats).
fees: Government ₹5,000 to ₹1.5 lakh per year; private ₹5 to ₹25 lakh per year (higher in deemed universities).
outcomes: Specialist and super-specialist doctors (DM/MCh via NEET SS), government hospitals, teaching posts, private practice.
salary: Resident stipend ₹60,000 to ₹1.2 lakh per month; consultants ₹15 to ₹60 LPA plus.

name: B.Ed / M.Ed and UGC NET (Lecturer & Teacher Track)
hindiTitle: बी.एड / यूजीसी नेट (असिस्टेंट प्रोफेसर व शिक्षक)
minQualification: Graduation for B.Ed / Master's for UGC NET
streamRequired: Graduation (min 50%) for B.Ed; Master's (55%) for NET
exam: State B.Ed CETs, CTET/State TET, UGC NET (for Assistant Professor and JRF), State SET.
eligibility: B.Ed requires graduation with 50 percent; UGC NET requires a Master's degree (55 percent general); JRF age limit 30 years with relaxations.
syllabus: UGC NET Paper 1 (Teaching and Research Aptitude, Reasoning, Comprehension, Data Interpretation, ICT; 50 questions) and Paper 2 (subject-specific; 100 questions); CTET covers Child Development, Pedagogy, Languages, Maths/Science/Social Studies.
competitionDetail: NET qualification rate is about 6 percent or less for Assistant Professor/JRF.
fees: B.Ed ₹30,000 to ₹1.2 lakh total; UGC NET fee about ₹325 to ₹1,150.
duration: B.Ed 2 years; NET preparation 6 to 18 months.
outcomes: TGT/PGT in KVS, NVS, state schools, Assistant Professor in colleges and universities, JRF with PhD scholarship.
salary: JRF about ₹37,000 per month; Assistant Professor Level 10 (₹57,700 to ₹1,82,400); TGT/PGT Level 7 to 8 (₹44,900 to ₹1,42,400); private school ₹3 to ₹7 LPA.

name: Global Finance Credentials (CFA, FRM, ACCA, CPA US)
exam: CFA Institute (Levels I, II, III), GARP FRM (Parts I and II), ACCA (13 papers across levels), AICPA CPA (4 sections).
eligibility: Graduation (final-year students allowed for CFA Level I); any stream, though Commerce, Economics or Engineering is preferred.
syllabus: Ethics, Quantitative Methods, Economics, Financial Statement Analysis, Corporate Issuers, Equity, Fixed Income, Derivatives, Portfolio Management (CFA); Risk Management and Valuation (FRM).
competitionDetail: High rigor (CFA Level I pass rates are around 40 percent, lower for Levels II and III).
fees: CFA about ₹80,000 to ₹1.3 lakh per level (enrolment plus registration); ACCA about ₹2 to ₹4 lakh total; CPA about ₹2 to ₹4 lakh.
duration: 2 to 4 years depending on the credential.
outcomes: Investment banker, equity research analyst, portfolio manager, risk analyst, global auditor, finance consultant.
salary: ₹5 to ₹15 LPA at entry; experienced charterholders ₹20 LPA to ₹1 crore.

name: Tech & Digital Skills (PG Diplomas & Industry Certs)
hindiTitle: टेक व डिजिटल स्किल्स (फुल-स्टैक / डेटा एनालिटिक्स / क्लाउड)
exam: No national exam; entry by college test or direct admission. Industry certifications: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, CompTIA, CEH, PMP, Scrum.
eligibility: Graduation in any stream (some programs require basic coding or Maths).
syllabus: Python, SQL, Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, Cyber Security, Full-Stack Development, Digital Marketing, UX Design, Data Analytics.
competitionDetail: Moderate to High in the job market (portfolio, Github projects and real skills matter far more than certificates).
fees: ₹50,000 to ₹3 lakh for programs; certification exams ₹8,000 to ₹30,000 each.
outcomes: Data analyst, software developer, cloud engineer, cyber security analyst, digital marketer, UX designer.
salary: ₹4 to ₹15 LPA depending on skill and company.

name: Study Abroad (MS, MBA, MEng)
exam: GRE (MS), GMAT/GRE (MBA), IELTS/TOEFL/PTE (English proficiency); SAT/ACT is for undergraduate only.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree with a good academic record (60 percent plus); relevant background for MS programs.
syllabus: GRE tests Verbal Reasoning, Quantitative Reasoning and Analytical Writing; IELTS tests Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.
competitionDetail: Moderate to Very High depending on the country and university ranking.
fees: Exam fees ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 each; tuition plus living ₹30 to ₹80 lakh total (Germany, some European countries much lower).
outcomes: International jobs (USA, Canada, UK, Germany, Australia), research positions, PhD pathways.
salary: Roughly USD 60,000 to USD 130,000 per year for tech and management in the US; lower in Europe and Australia.

name: Entrepreneurship and Startups
exam: No exam; incubation programs and competitions such as Startup India, Atal Incubation Centres, IIM and IIT incubators; Mudra and Stand-Up India loans.
eligibility: None; age 18 and above for business registration.
syllabus: Business model design, market research, finance and funding, marketing, legal compliance, product development.
competitionDetail: High risk market environment (most startups fail in the first 5 years).
fees: Registration and compliance ₹5,000 to ₹50,000; initial capital depends on the business.
outcomes: Business owner, founder, franchise partner, freelancer, consultant.
salary: Highly variable; from losses in early years to ₹10 lakh to several crores for successful ventures.

name: UPSC Civil Services (IAS, IPS, IFS & 20+ Services)
hindiTitle: संघ लोक सेवा आयोग (आईएएस / आईपीएस / आईएफएस)
exam: Civil Services Examination in three stages: Prelims, Mains and Personality Test (Interview).
eligibility: Graduation in any stream; age 21 to 32 (General), 35 (OBC), 37 (SC/ST); 6 attempts for General/EWS, 9 for OBC, unlimited for SC/ST until the age limit.
syllabus: Prelims: GS Paper I (History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Environment, Science and Technology, Current Affairs) and CSAT Paper II (qualifying, 33 percent). Mains: Essay (250), GS I to IV (250 each), Optional Subject (2 papers, 250 each), plus qualifying Indian Language and English papers; Interview 275 marks.
competitionDetail: Extreme (about 10 to 13 lakh applications for roughly 1,000 vacancies; final selection is well under 1 percent).
fees: ₹100 (nil for women, SC, ST, PwBD); coaching and books ₹50,000 to ₹3 lakh if opted.
duration: Preparation usually 1 to 3 years; training at LBSNAA (IAS) 2 years.
outcomes: IAS, IPS, IFS, IRS, IRTS, IAAS and other Group A services; District Magistrate, Superintendent of Police, Ambassador, Commissioner, and top administrative roles.
salary: Entry Pay Level 10 (₹56,100) rising to Level 17 (₹2.25 lakh) and Cabinet Secretary (₹2.5 lakh); total benefits with housing, vehicle and staff.

name: State Public Service Commission (State PCS, e.g., BPSC, UPPSC)
hindiTitle: राज्य लोक सेवा आयोग (बीपीएससी / यूपीपीएससी / एसडीएम / डीएसपी)
exam: Prelims, Mains and Interview conducted by each state PSC.
eligibility: Graduation; age typically 21 to 37 depending on state and category; domicile benefits in some states.
syllabus: General Studies (History, Geography, Polity, Economy, State-specific topics, Current Affairs), CSAT-type paper in some states, optional papers or Hindi/English language papers, and Interview.
competitionDetail: Very High (lakhs of candidates for a few hundred to a thousand state posts).
fees: ₹100 to ₹750 depending on state and category.
duration: 1 to 2 years preparation; recruitment cycle 8 to 18 months.
outcomes: Deputy Collector/SDM, DSP, Block Development Officer, Commercial Tax Officer, District Panchayati Raj Officer, state finance and revenue services.
salary: State pay Level 8 to 11 (roughly ₹47,600 to ₹1.5 lakh); in-hand about ₹60,000 to ₹1 lakh with allowances.

name: SSC CGL (Combined Graduate Level)
exam: Tier 1 (CBT, 100 questions, 60 minutes), Tier 2 (CBT with multiple papers and a Computer Proficiency/Data Entry Skill Test for some posts).
eligibility: Graduation (some posts need Commerce/Maths in 12th or CA/CS/MBA/Statistics); age 18 to 32 depending on post, with relaxations.
syllabus: General Intelligence and Reasoning, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude (Graduation-level Maths) and English Comprehension; Tier 2 adds Statistics or General Studies (Finance and Economics) for specific posts.
competitionDetail: Extreme (about 30 lakh candidates for roughly 15,000 to 20,000 posts in typical years).
fees: ₹100 (nil for women, SC, ST, PwBD, ESM).
duration: 12 to 18 months for the full cycle.
outcomes: Assistant Section Officer (CSS/IB), Income Tax Inspector, Central Excise Inspector, Auditor (CAG), Assistant Audit Officer, Sub-Inspector (CBI), Tax Assistant, Statistical Investigator.
salary: Pay Level 4 to 8 (₹25,500 to ₹1,12,400 depending on post); in-hand ₹40,000 to ₹80,000 per month in metro cities.

name: Bank PO (IBPS PO / SBI PO)
hindiTitle: बैंक पीओ (आईबीपीएस एवं एसबीआई प्रोबेशनरी ऑफिसर)
exam: Preliminary, Main (objective plus descriptive) and Interview (IBPS PO also has a Group Discussion at some banks; SBI PO has Group Exercise and Interview).
eligibility: Graduation in any stream; age 20 to 30 with relaxations.
syllabus: English Language, Quantitative Aptitude (Data Interpretation, Arithmetic), Reasoning Ability and Computer Aptitude, General/Financial/Banking Awareness, Descriptive Writing (Letter and Essay).
competitionDetail: Very High (lakhs of applicants for about 4,000 to 5,000 IBPS posts; SBI PO about 600 to 2,000 posts).
fees: ₹850 (₹175 for SC/ST/PwBD) for IBPS; SBI PO about ₹750.
duration: 6 to 10 months for the selection process; 2 years of probation.
outcomes: Probationary Officer, then Assistant Manager, Manager, Chief Manager and General Manager through promotions.
salary: Starting basic about ₹48,480; total package about ₹9 to ₹14 LPA (CTC) in the first years.

name: Bank Clerk (IBPS Clerk / SBI Junior Associate)
hindiTitle: बैंक क्लर्क (आईबीपीएस क्लर्क / एसबीआई जूनियर एसोसिएट)
exam: Preliminary and Main exam (objective); local language test.
eligibility: Graduation in any stream; age 20 to 28 with relaxations; computer literacy and local language knowledge.
syllabus: English, Numerical Ability, Reasoning Ability, General/Financial Awareness, Computer Knowledge.
competitionDetail: Extreme (lakhs of candidates for about 5,000 to 10,000 vacancies).
fees: ₹850 (₹175 for SC/ST/PwBD) for IBPS; SBI about ₹750.
outcomes: Clerk, then Assistant Manager, Officer and Branch Manager through promotions and internal exams (JAIIB, CAIIB).
salary: Basic about ₹24,050 with gross approximately ₹30,000 to ₹40,000 per month (about ₹5 to ₹6.5 LPA).

name: RBI Grade B, NABARD Grade A, SEBI Grade A, LIC AAO
hindiTitle: आरबीआई ग्रेड बी / सेबी / नाबार्ड / एलआईसी एएओ
streamRequired: Graduation with at least 60% (or PG with 55%)
exam: Phase I (objective), Phase II (descriptive and objective, subject-specific papers) and Interview; NABARD and SEBI have specialised streams.
eligibility: Graduation with at least 60 percent (RBI Grade B General, 50 percent for SC/ST) or a Postgraduate degree with 55 percent; age 21 to 30 with relaxations.
syllabus: General Awareness, English, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning (Phase I); Economic and Social Issues, English Writing Skills, Finance and Management (RBI Phase II); Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD).
competitionDetail: Extreme (RBI Grade B receives lakhs of applications for about 100 to 300 posts).
fees: ₹850 (₹100 for SC/ST/PwBD) for RBI; similar for others.
outcomes: Officer in the central bank, regulatory authorities or insurance; fast promotions to Assistant Manager, Manager, Chief General Manager.
salary: RBI Grade B starting basic about ₹78,450 with gross around ₹1.3 to ₹1.8 lakh per month (about ₹16 to ₹22 LPA); NABARD and SEBI are similar.

name: SSC CPO, UPSC CAPF (AC) and State Police Sub-Inspector
hindiTitle: एसएससी सीपीओ / अर्धसैनिक बल सहायक कमांडेंट / दारोगा (एसआई)
exam: SSC CPO: Paper 1 (CBT), Physical Standard and Efficiency Tests, Paper 2 (English), Medical. UPSC CAPF AC: Written paper (2 papers), PST/PET, Interview. State SI: written exam, PST/PET and Medical.
eligibility: Graduation; age 20 to 25 (CPO and CAPF) with relaxations; State SI usually 20 to 28; physical standards apply (height, chest and running tests).
syllabus: General Intelligence and Reasoning, GK and Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude, English; CAPF adds General Studies, Essay and Comprehension.
competitionDetail: Extreme for CAPF AC and SSC CPO; Very High for State SI.
fees: ₹100 (SSC CPO) and ₹200 (UPSC CAPF); state fees ₹100 to ₹700.
duration: About 1 year of selection; training of 6 to 12 months.
outcomes: Sub-Inspector (Delhi Police, CAPF, CISF ASI), Assistant Commandant (BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP, SSB), Sub-Inspector in state police.
salary: SI roles Pay Level 6 (₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400); CAPF Assistant Commandant Level 10 (₹56,100 to ₹1,77,500) plus allowances.

name: RRB NTPC (Graduate Level Posts - Station Master / Goods Guard)
hindiTitle: रेलवे एनटीपीसी स्नातक पद (स्टेशन मास्टर / गुड्स गार्ड)
exam: CBT 1, CBT 2, Typing Skill Test or Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT) for certain posts, document verification, medical.
eligibility: Graduation (degree required for Station Master, Goods Guard, Senior Commercial cum Ticket Clerk, Junior Accounts Assistant, Traffic Assistant); age 18 to 33 with relaxations.
syllabus: General Awareness, Mathematics and General Intelligence and Reasoning (Class 10 to graduation level).
competitionDetail: Extreme (1 crore plus applicants for about 8,000 to 12,000 vacancies in some cycles).
fees: ₹500 (₹250 for reserved categories; partly refundable).
outcomes: Station Master, Goods Train Manager, Commercial Apprentice, Senior Clerk cum Typist, Traffic Assistant; promotions to Station Superintendent and officer posts via LDCE.
salary: Pay Level 4 to 6 (₹25,500 to ₹35,400 initially); in-hand about ₹35,000 to ₹55,000 per month.

name: Engineering Government Jobs (UPSC ESE, SSC JE, RRB JE, PSUs)
hindiTitle: इंजीनियरिंग सरकारी नौकरियां (ईएसई / एसएससी जेई / पीएसयू गेट)
streamRequired: B.E./B.Tech or Diploma (Civil, Mech, Electrical, Electronics)
exam: UPSC ESE (Prelims, Mains, Interview), SSC JE (Paper I and II), RRB JE (CBT 1 and 2), PSU recruitment through GATE score (ONGC, IOCL, NTPC, BHEL, Power Grid, GAIL, SAIL).
eligibility: B.E./B.Tech (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics) for ESE and PSUs; Diploma or B.Tech for SSC/RRB JE; age 18 to 30 (ESE 21 to 30).
syllabus: Core engineering subjects of your branch, Engineering Mathematics, General Aptitude, General Awareness and Reasoning.
competitionDetail: Extreme for ESE and PSUs (hundreds of posts for lakhs of candidates); High for SSC/RRB JE.
fees: ₹200 (ESE), ₹100 (SSC JE), ₹500 (RRB JE); GATE about ₹1,000 to ₹2,000.
duration: 6 to 18 months of selection; 1 to 2 years of preparation typically.
outcomes: Indian Railway Service of Engineers, Central Engineering Services, Junior Engineer at PWD/CPWD/Railways, Executive Trainee Engineer in PSUs.
salary: ESE Group A Level 10 (₹56,100 to ₹1,77,500); SSC/RRB JE Level 6 (₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400); PSU about ₹12 to ₹20 LPA CTC.

name: Armed Forces Officer Entry for Graduates (CDS, AFCAT, NCC Entry)
hindiTitle: सैन्य अधिकारी स्नातक प्रवेश (सीडीएस / एफकैट / आईएमए / ओटीए)
streamRequired: Any for IMA/OTA; Engg for INA; Maths+Physics/Engg for AFA
exam: UPSC CDS (written exam, SSB interview, medical) for IMA, INA, AFA and OTA; AFCAT for the Air Force; NCC Special Entry (SSB without written exam).
eligibility: Graduation for IMA/OTA/NCC; Engineering degree for INA; Physics and Maths in Class 12 or B.E. for AFA; age 19 to 25 (varies by academy); unmarried (for IMA/INA/AFA).
syllabus: CDS: English, General Knowledge, Elementary Mathematics (not for OTA); AFCAT: General Awareness, Verbal Ability, Numerical Ability, Reasoning and Military Aptitude; followed by SSB.
competitionDetail: Extreme (3 to 4 lakh candidates for roughly 400 to 500 CDS vacancies; AFCAT is also very tough).
fees: ₹200 (CDS, nil for women/SC/ST); AFCAT about ₹550.
duration: Training of 49 weeks to 18 months depending on the academy.
outcomes: Commissioned Officer (Lieutenant, Sub Lieutenant, Flying Officer) with Permanent or Short Service Commission; Param Vishisht Seva medals, command positions, post-service CAPF and corporate roles.
salary: Cadet stipend ₹56,100 per month; Level 10 (₹56,100 to ₹1,77,500) plus Military Service Pay (₹15,500) and allowances; in-hand roughly ₹1 lakh plus.

name: Judicial Services (State PCS-J / Civil Judge)
streamRequired: LLB Degree (3 or 5 years) eligible for bar enrollment
exam: State Judicial Service exam (Prelims, Mains and Interview/Viva) conducted by the High Court or State PSC.
eligibility: LLB degree (3 or 5 years), eligible for enrolment as an advocate; age 21 to 35 depending on state, with relaxations; some states need 3 years of practice.
syllabus: Constitution, Civil Procedure Code, Criminal Procedure Code, Indian Penal Code/BNS, Evidence Act, Contract Act, Transfer of Property Act, local laws, language and judgment writing.
competitionDetail: Very High to Extreme (a handful of seats per state for lakhs of candidates).
fees: ₹500 to ₹1,500 depending on the state.
duration: 1 to 2 years of preparation; training at the judicial academy.
outcomes: Civil Judge (Junior Division)/Judicial Magistrate; promotion to Senior Civil Judge, District Judge and High Court judge through a defined career path.
salary: About ₹77,840 to ₹1,36,520 basic for entry-level judges (varies by state), plus allowances and perks.

name: Indian Forest Service (IFoS)
streamRequired: Bachelor's in Botany, Chemistry, Geology, Maths, Physics, Zoology, Agri or Engg
exam: UPSC Civil Services Prelims (common), then a separate IFoS Mains and Personality Test.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree with at least one subject from Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Science, Botany, Chemistry, Geology, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Zoology, or a degree in Agriculture, Forestry or Engineering; age 21 to 32 with relaxations.
syllabus: General English and General Knowledge papers plus two optional subjects (2 papers each) from the above list; interview 300 marks.
competitionDetail: Extreme (about 100 to 150 vacancies per year nationwide).
fees: ₹100 (nil for women/SC/ST/PwBD).
duration: 1 to 3 years preparation; training of 2 years at IGNFA, Dehradun.
outcomes: Forest Officer (DFO), wildlife conservation, environment ministry roles and Principal Chief Conservator of Forests.
salary: Pay Level 10 (₹56,100) entry rising with seniority; perks include official residence and vehicle.
